[[Image:Lomi.jpg|300px|thumb|right|POMI office building at 27, [[Fontanka|Fontanka River]] embankment, [[St. Petersburg]]]]
The '''St. Petersburg Department of Steklov Institute of Mathematics of the Russian Academy of Sciences''' ({{langx|ru|Санкт-Петербургское отделение Математического института им. В. А. Стеклова РАН}}, abbreviated ПОМИ ('''PDMI''') for "Петербургское отделение Математического института", Petersburg Department of the Mathematical Institute; PDMI) is a mathematical research institute in [[St. Petersburg]], part of the [[Russian Academy of Sciences]]. Until 1992 it was known as '''Leningrad Department of Steklov Institute of Mathematics of the [[USSR Academy of Sciences]]''' (ЛОМИ, LOMI).

The name of the institution is a historical tradition and since 1995 it has no subordination to the [[Steklov Institute of Mathematics]].<ref name=hist/>

The institute was established in 1940 as a department of the Steklov Institute and is named after [[Vladimir Andreevich Steklov]], a [[Soviet Union|Soviet]]/[[Russians|Russian]] [[mathematician]], [[mechanics|mechanician]] and [[physicist]].<ref name=hist>[http://www.imi.ras.ru/ru/institut/history.php Institute history]</ref>

== Directors ==

* V. A. Tartakovskii (1940–1941)
* [[Andrey Markov, Jr.]] (1942–1953)
* Nikolai Erugin (1953–1957)
* Georgii Petrashen' (1957–1976)
* [[Ludvig Faddeev]] (1976–2000)
* [[Ildar Abdulovich Ibragimov]] (2000–2006)
* [[:ru:Кисляков,_Сергей_Витальевич|Sergei Kislyakov]] (2007–2021)
* [[:ru:Всемирнов,_Максим_Александрович|Maxim Vsemirnov]] (2021–present)
